page.layout: One page of running text. Margin notes in the right margin (3. op-pressio beside the "Ruffia Tartaris subjecta" heading; 4. in-staura-tio beside the line "Magnum Ducem").

main_text.head: Periodus II.
Russia Tartaris subjecta.3. op-pressio
main_text.p: A. C. 1224 Tartari Duce Bathi universam Russiam potestati suæ subjecerunt; quæ servitus usq; ad A. C. 1500 duravit. Tum tempo-ris enim Johannes Basilides primum4. in-staura-tio Magnum Ducem omnium Rus-sorum appellavit, & Tartaros Ruf-fiâ expulit.
main_text.head: Russia Nigra accessit Polo-niæ.
main_text.p: Circa A. C. 1300 Poloni, captâ Kioviâ Russiam Nigram sibi subjecerunt, in quorum potestate mansit ad nostra usq; tempora, donec nuperrimè Luce Cossacorum Chmilenzki ad Moscovitas defecerunt.

page.notes: Printed marks "3." and "4." are the margin note numbers; the note words are as printed, with long s written as plain s. "pressio" is partly worn ("prcssio" on the scan), so the ending is read with [?]: pressio[?]. Lines at the top edge show the neighbouring page and are left out. The catchword "Ca-" is a half word, as printed.
